notes.title: Toastercide 0.92:
notes.content:
Toaster now becomes transparent if the camera is too close/the toaster is blocking the camera
Electricity indicators no longer show up over UI
Added More toasts and trees to Turrell Level
Added Lamposts near entrances in hub level
Moved starting toasts, and opened more windows/doors in bezos level exterior 
Added Asteroids to Space level
Invincibility and healing toast now have dashes associated with them
Bouncy toast now reduces damage even more, from 0.5 to 0.25 base damage
Fixed bug where player could not exit from credits
FPS Settings should load properly on startup. 
Added Car colliders to front of JFK cars
Added Zero-G Toast 
Added enemy AI to Space Level
